when: Each time the pacer starts one (no schedule)
does: One unattended cloud session on Opus at effort low: reads your feedback, triages new issues, does tickets (one PR each) and reports each run on the branch metrics; never takes a lane:haiku or lane:deep ticket

when: Only when the pacer starts one; a new session each time
does: One unattended cloud session on Haiku: does one lane:haiku ticket (one PR) and stops; no triage, refill or review
where: Scheduled task “travel-aggregator autopilot haiku” (/scheduled max lane haiku)

when: Only when the pacer starts one; a new session each time
does: One unattended cloud session on Opus at effort high: the lane:deep tickets, the epic checks (README PR and scripts/preview_check.sh at the end of an epic), the queue refill, the roadmap review and the process review
where: Scheduled task “travel-aggregator autopilot deep” (/scheduled max lane deep), .claude/skills/autopilot/queue.md

when: A cycle every 10 minutes (one loop of about 5.5 hours, then the next)
does: A script with no Claude session: reads the 5-hour and 7-day usage and starts runs through the API triggers of the tasks; also starts the dashboard and the dashboard site each cycle

when: Each ticket
does: lane:haiku for clear size:S tickets, lane:deep for hard choices; Opus runs never take a reserved lane

when: Each ticket a run starts
does: A claim ref per ticket, so that two runs never do the same ticket; a run beats it while it works

when: When the open epics have no ready ticket
does: A deep run makes the next epic and its first sub-issues from the roadmap (one goal after the other)

when: After a gap of merged PRs (80 at the start)
does: A deep run reviews the agent system and makes the changes that pay

when: Any time
does: Issues and comments, priority labels, decision tickets, and the files steering/project/PRINCIPLES.md and ROADMAP.md

when: Each PR and each merge to main
does: Lint (ruff) and the fast tests against PostgreSQL 16; Automerge waits for it

when: Each PR and each merge to main
does: docker compose up --build with .env.example: migrations, /api/health with the commit, non-root user, healthcheck, login with a CSRF token up to the trips list

when: After green checks on main
does: Builds and pushes ghcr.io/larspolo/travel-aggregator:preview (only the newest commit of main)

when: Watchtower polls every 5 minutes
does: Runs :preview with its own database behind Traefik at travel-preview.larspolo.nl; basic auth on the pages, none on /api

when: At the end of each epic
does: Waits until the preview runs the newest main, then tests the API with the token of the network secret

when: After each CI run, and every 5 minutes
does: Merges a green agent PR (squash), closes its ticket, starts CI on main

when: Every 20 minutes
does: Merges main into an agent PR with a conflict that git solves alone

when: After merges, and once a day
does: Deletes the claim refs of closed tickets

when: Each hour, and after merges
does: Closes each issue with the label close (a run adds it after its evidence comment)

when: Each pacer cycle (and every 10 minutes)
does: Writes the dashboard into the body of the status issue #1

when: Each pacer cycle (and every 30 minutes)
does: Builds this page and its data files and publishes them on GitHub Pages

when: Four times an hour, and each pacer cycle
does: Copies the run reports of the status issue to the branch metrics, for the usage charts
